projects.title: Main Breaker Box & Wiring Cleanup

projects.afterSummary: Cleanly wired breaker box with clear labels for each room.

projects.title: Bathroom Sink & Mixer Tap Fitting

projects.beforeSummary: Old dripping bathroom tap and leaking drain pipe under the sink.
projects.afterSummary: New mixer tap, sealed drain connection, and dry cabinet underneath.

projects.title: Kitchen Cabinets & Room Door Repair
projects.description: Adjusted crooked kitchen cabinet shutters, fitted soft-close hinges, and planed a sticking bedroom door.
projects.beforeSummary: Hanging cabinet doors, broken hinges, and a door that scraped the floor.
projects.afterSummary: Straight cabinets with smooth hinges and a door that closes quietly.
